environment.description: Spring Boot application running in a Docker container based on eclipse-temurin:17-jre with default container configuration. Container runs as root user. Volume mount maps /app/data to host filesystem. No read-only filesystem enforcement. Standard Docker default capabilities (includes CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE, CAP_CHOWN, CAP_FOWNER). No seccomp profile customization beyond Docker defaults.

config.filesystem_permissions: container process has write access to entire filesystem
